hooks.name: aidlc-session-start
hooks.description: Starts an AIDLC session: notes the session opened and gives the assistant the current workflow context.

hooks.name: aidlc-session-start-cli
hooks.description: Same start as the SessionStart entry, for the CLI. Session Start fires on the IDE only and Agent Spawn on the CLI only, so one shell serving both surfaces registers both; the handler keys its work by session id, so a surface that fired the other name is a no-op.
